name: lever standing one leg calf raise
description: Standing on one foot with pads on your shoulders, you rise onto your toes and lower back down. Isolates the calf of the working leg.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your height and stand with one foot on the platform, the other leg lifted clear.
Place your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heel as high as possible by extending your ankle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
